$comment: Cosmetics of the Storm Calligraphy set (Legends Showcase capsule machine), written by art/machine-specs.mjs from career/machines/legends-showcase.json: edit that file and re-run, not this one.
style: sweeping sumi-e ink and electric cobalt watercolor with violent silver lightning and vermilion seal accents
rules: These are full-art pictures for playing cards: the client draws a small name plate over the top edge, mana symbols at the top right and power and toughness at the bottom right, so keep the main subject in the middle of the panel and the top 15% and bottom 15% calm and uncluttered (sky, ground, water, background texture), with nothing important in the corners. Each panel shows its own subject as one clear, readable scene, the same style and palette as its neighbours, as if the whole row were a matched, limited-edition art series.
spare: an extra painting in the same style: whirling ribbons of obsidian ink spiraling around a shadowed mage in a tempest

items.subject: whirling ribbons of obsidian ink spiraling around a shadowed mage in a tempest
a cascading volley of glowing scarlet-and-amber firebolts streaking across ink-black clouds
burning parchment scrolls swirling upward into a bright phoenix-shaped pillar of fire
a surging silhouette wave of tiny horned warriors pouring out of jagged canyon tunnels
a floating gilded ring-orb channeling brilliant sapphire plasma arcs across a dark dome

the BACK of a playing card in the same style: a symmetrical ornamental design (it is seen upside down too) with a central emblem drawn from this set's theme, framed by a painted border; no logo, no oval, no five dots, no lettering
